value.rationale: The originating study highlights robust-chaos dynamics and short periodic coexistence as sources of bifurcation complexity. The theorem supplies an exhaustive globally valid strict period-three indicator census in a natural full 4-parameter two-saddle sector, a qualitative obstruction to LRR attracting cycles, and an explicit open sink-plus-saddle coexistence region with sharp -1 boundary. This is not merely a selected numerical orbit or parameter substitution; it resolves both allowed symbolic classes with certified stability, while appropriately limiting switching and higher-period claims.
